modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: A carry-on that does not fit the template is checked in as regular luggage.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: One small carry-on bag that fits the 56cm x 40cm x 25cm template.

carryon_weight.value: The carry-on must not exceed 5 kilos.

personal_item.value: One personal item (for example a purse or computer bag) is allowed in addition to the carry-on.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Luggage over the allowance is accepted subject to space, with a charge per kilo and per additional bag that depends on the route.

allowance.value: One checked bag of 23 kg per person on all international flights to and from Canada and on direct flights to and from Paris, including connections onto Air France in Montreal (30 kilos for Air France Business or Premium passengers).

magdalen_islands.value: To and from the Magdalen Islands (Cessna F406): the 23kg allowance must be split into two smaller bags; 50€ per additional bag.

infant.value: Infants under 2 travelling on a parent's lap: 10 Kg allowance (and/or a small additional bag).

excess_fees.value: Excess charges, 32kg per bag maximum: St. John's (YYT) 1.63€ per kilo and 50€ per additional bag; Halifax (YHZ) 2.84€ per kilo and 50€ per additional bag; Montreal (YUL) 4.08€ per kilo and 100€ per additional bag; Paris 6.05€ per kilo and 200€ per additional bag.

phone_home_market.notes: Listed in the contact footer of Air Saint-Pierre's luggage page.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference
